validity.researcher_notes: P2628 Tri-State Corridor Pipeline Project is a real, formally proposed FERC-certificated project (docket CP19-473) by Equitrans Midstream Corp. Specifications (17 mi, 16-inch, 140 MMcf/d, $96M) consistently documented in EIA and FERC records. Proposed May 2019, scheduled for in-service by 2021, but project was shelved and withdrawn by Equitrans in 2022. Application withdrawn per EIA; ShelvedCancelledType='inferred' should be 'confirmed' once FERC withdrawal order is located. Location typo corrected: 'West Virgina' -> 'West Virginia' (Trinity, Washington County PA to Brook County WV). All data points verified through EIA and FERC sources except exact FERC withdrawal order.
